visibleEditorialCopy.curiosityHook: What happens when the hidden brother inside the basket is finally unleashed against the surgeons who cut them apart?
visibleEditorialCopy.description: Carrying a large wicker basket that hides his severely deformed, formerly conjoined twin brother, a young man arrives in the city seeking bloody vengeance against the doctors who separated them against their will.
visibleEditorialCopy.vibeSummary: Grimy, suspenseful horror-comedy with heavy undertones, balancing shocking absurdity with a steady, focused pace.
visibleEditorialCopy.whyWatch: Frank Henenlotter blends grotesque horror with pitch-black comedy, delivering a singular revenge tale driven by macabre brotherly devotion and pure midnight-movie energy.
